title: atropis kjellmannii
intro: Atropis kjellmannii, commonly known as Qianghao or Angelica keiskei, is a plant species native to East Asia. This plant is rich in bioactive compounds and has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The therapeutic actions of Atropis kjellmannii include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and inhibit cancer cell growth. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, lignans, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
